sources.finding: Ampere SM 8.6 is supported; TensorRT-RTX packages target CUDA 12.9 Update 1 or CUDA 13.4.

sources.family: TensorRT-RTX architecture, runtime, shapes, quantization, cache, CUDA graphs
sources.finding: AOT/JIT, shape specialization, runtime-cache identity, and Q/DQ precision evidence are separate proof gates.
Streams, asynchronous operations, memory pools, and CUDA Graphs remain runtime concerns, not identity authority.

sources.family: PyTorch C++/ATen, activation checkpointing, custom operators
sources.finding: PyTorch C++/ATen provide the CPU/GPU reference boundary; activation checkpointing is training-memory policy and custom operators require registered operator contracts. No native integration is authorized here.
Node-API is ABI-stable and independent of V8; node-addon-api is the C++ binding. A future addon must use Node-API exclusively for ABI stability. No addon is built here.
cuVS brute force is the exact bounded semantic reference; CAGRA is an approximate graph challenger and may interoperate with HNSW. Neither becomes identity or an extra vote.

sources.family: ONNX Runtime execution providers, DirectML, WebGPU
sources.finding: Providers are independent executor surfaces; current DirectML metadata is not an execution receipt and WebGPU parity remains unadmitted.
